platform: WordPress (Yoast, Toolset, Beaver Builder); custom post type 'catalog' (not WooCommerce; wc/store API 404)
catalog_endpoint: https://lewelectric.com/catalog-sitemap.xml - 396 URLs https://lewelectric.com/catalog/<sku-lowercase>/ each with <image:loc> (395 have an image). Product pages also have og:image.
sku_format_match: yes - slug = SKU lowercased; 12/12 sample SKUs present as /catalog/<sku>/
recommended_strategy: Single request: parse catalog-sitemap.xml <url> blocks -> {slug.upper(): image:loc}. Match SKU exactly (case-insensitive). Image sizes vary (some 1000px, older ones 350px); og:image on the page gives the same file.
